final: WITH site_avg AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS z, s.entrystat AS st, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS a FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat HAVING AVG(m.facetfaces) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS o FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), st_avg AS (SELECT st, AVG(a) AS sa FROM site_avg WHERE st IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st), above AS (SELECT site_avg.a AS a, overall.o AS o, st_avg.sa AS sa FROM site_avg JOIN st_avg ON site_avg.st = st_avg.st CROSS JOIN overall WHERE site_avg.a > st_avg.sa) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_faces, AVG(a - o) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(a - sa) AS avg_above_status FROM above
